en_title: Modern Warfare 4 Pays Tribute to Call of Duty Co-Creator Vince Zampella
cn_title: 《使命召唤》《现代战争4》致敬系列缔造者
subtitle: 铭记他们的贡献
opus_summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》在战役片尾字幕中致敬系列联合创作者，他于去年12月因车祸离世。玩家完成最终任务后，画面首先列出他与其他在制作期间离世者的姓名。

paragraphs.en: Last December, co-creator of Call of Duty and co-founder of Respawn Entertainment, Vince Zampella, passed away in a car accident . He left behind an enduring legacy as one of the people who shaped first-person shooters and changed video games forever.
paragraphs.cn: 去年12月，《使命召唤》联合创作者、Respawn Entertainment联合创始人Vince Zampella因车祸离世。他参与塑造了第一人称射击游戏，也永久改变了电子游戏，留下了影响深远的遗产。

paragraphs.en: This week saw the release of Modern Warfare 4, the latest entry in a series that Zampella led the inception of almost 20 years ago in 2007. His contribution is honoured by his former studio, Infinity Ward, in the credits for its campaign.
paragraphs.cn: 《现代战争4》于本周发售。这一系列由Zampella在近20年前的2007年牵头开创，如今迎来了最新作。他曾效力的工作室Infinity Ward在本作战役的片尾字幕中致敬了他的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Upon completion of the game’s final mission, which takes place midway through the credits, his name and the others belonging to those who have sadly passed away during its production are the first to appear on screen. These include Rainer Yang, Matt Canale, and Preetam Raj Bordoloi, who also helped craft Call of Duty over the years.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏的最终任务穿插在片尾字幕中段。玩家完成这一任务后，画面首先出现的是他的名字，以及其他在本作制作期间不幸离世者的姓名。其中包括Rainer Yang、Matt Canale和Preetam Raj Bordoloi，他们多年来也曾参与打造《使命召唤》。

paragraphs.en: Zampella was instrumental in turning COD into the megafranchise it is today, initially leaving EA after leading design on Medal of Honor: Allied Assault to create the series, before later returning to found Respawn Entertainment, which went on to develop the Titanfall and Star Wars Jedi games. He will, perhaps, always be known best, though, for the development of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, which not only stands tall today as one of the greatest FPS campaigns ever made, but also changed how online multiplayer shooters are played to this day.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤》能成为今天这样的庞大系列，Zampella发挥了关键作用。他在主导《荣誉勋章：联合袭击》的设计后离开EA，创立了《使命召唤》系列，后来又回归并创办Respawn Entertainment。该工作室随后开发了《泰坦陨落》和《星球大战绝地》系列游戏。不过，他最广为人知的成就，或许始终会是开发了《使命召唤：现代战争4》。这部作品的战役至今仍跻身史上最出色的FPS战役之列，同时也改变了在线多人射击游戏的玩法，影响延续至今。

paragraphs.en: His legacy is honoured in Modern Warfare 4, and it's fitting that it happens to be one of the strongest entries in the series in many years , with fans praising it and the game’s very own Captain Price thanking them .
paragraphs.cn: 《现代战争4》向他留下的遗产致敬，而本作恰好也是该系列多年来最出色的作品之一，这样的纪念再合适不过。粉丝们纷纷称赞本作，连游戏中的普莱斯上尉也向他们表达了感谢。
